title: 2012 AMC 8 Problem 3
statement: On February \(13\) The Oshkosh Northwester listed the length of daylight as \(10\) hours and \(24\) minutes, the sunrise as \(6:57\text{ AM},\) and the sunset as \( 8:15\text{PM} .\) The length of daylight and sunrise were correct, but the sunset was wrong. When did the sun really set?

solutions.text:
Since \(10\) hours after \(6:57 \text{AM} \) is \(4:57 \text{PM} ,\) we can then say \(10\) hours and \(3\) minutes after sunrise is \(5:00 \text{PM} .\) We then have \(21\) more minutes until sunset, so sunset is \(5:21 \text{PM} .\)

Thus, the answer is B .
hints: Add the correct daylight length to the sunrise time.
From \(6:57\) AM to noon is \(5\) hours \(3\) minutes.
